lines.en: label saralust20x:
scene saraharukaxmas1
with fade
play music "calmbar.mp3"
As requested of me last night, I make my way over to Sara’s unnamed bar to help her “decorate” the place.
lines.zh: 按她昨晚对我的要求，我动身前往 Sara 那家没名字的酒吧，帮她“布置”场地。

lines.en: If you’re wondering why I’m putting “decorate” in quotes, it's because I’m really here to just watch her do the work and provide her some moral support if the need arises.
lines.zh: 如果你好奇我为什么要给“布置”加上引号——那是因为我其实只是来这儿看她干活、并在需要时给她一点精神支持的。

lines.en: Or at least that {i}would{/i} have been the plan if Haruka wasn’t here helping out as well.
lines.zh: 至少，如果 Haruka 没来帮忙的话，{i}本来就该是{/i}这个计划。

lines.en: It’s significantly harder to feel comfortable with my lack of effort when other people without the obligation to do so start lending a hand as well.
lines.zh: 当其他本没有义务的人也开始伸手帮忙时，我就很难心安理得地继续偷懒了。

lines.en: Thank you for ruining my morning, Haruka. And thank you, Sara, for enabling her to do that.
lines.zh: 谢谢你毁了我的早晨，Haruka。也谢谢你，Sara，是你让她有机会这么干的。

lines.en: : You know, I’m a little surprised you decided to show up this morning.
lines.zh: : 说真的，你今早居然决定来，我有点意外。

lines.en: : I was only half serious when I asked Sana to invite you over since I know you normally stiff me when it comes to stuff like holiday get-togethers.
lines.zh: : 我让 Sana 叫你过来的时候只有半句是认真的，因为我清楚这种节日聚会的事你一般是会放我鸽子的。

lines.en: : That’s where you’re wrong, Sara. In fact, I can recall a large number of times where I have stiffed you {i}without{/i} needing to use a party as an excuse to get away.
lines.zh: : 这你可就说错了，Sara。事实上，我可以举出很多次我放你鸽子的例子，而且根本{i}不需要{/i}拿派对当借口脱身。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas2
with dissolve
: Me too. But I think you’re talking about the good, hot kind of stiffing and not the kind where you leave me all by myself.
lines.zh: : 我也是。不过我猜你说的那个“放鸽子”是那种又爽又火热的，不是把我一个人丢下不管的那种。

lines.en: : Dude.
lines.zh: : 老兄。

lines.en: : So, do you really expect tonight to be busy? Or is that just a thing you told your daughter to prevent her from worrying about your future?
lines.zh: : 所以，你是真觉得今晚会很忙？还是说那只是你跟你女儿编的、好让她不为你的将来发愁的说法？

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas3
with dissolve
: Hey! I really {i}do{/i} expect it to be busy. We have a whole party thing booked.
lines.zh: : 喂！我是{i}真的{/i}觉得会忙。我们可是包下了一整场派对。

lines.en: : Do you really think I would have woken up this early if I wasn’t prepared to work my butt off?
lines.zh: : 你觉得如果没准备把屁股累断，我会这么早就爬起来吗？

lines.en: : And do you really think I would have come here to help if I didn’t think there was at least a little bit of truth to that?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得，如果不是觉得这话至少有那么点可信，我会来这儿帮忙吗？

lines.en: : Isn’t the cafe closed today?
lines.zh: : 咖啡馆今天不是关门吗？

lines.en: : You know, I really don’t see how that’s relevant.
lines.zh: : 我说，我真看不出这有什么关系。

lines.en: : Sure. Anyway, which one of you do I ask for a beer?
lines.zh: : 好吧。总之，我该找你们两个谁要啤酒？

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas4
with dissolve
: A beer? It’s like...nine in the morning.
lines.zh: : 啤酒？现在才……早上九点吧。

lines.en: : I have nothing to lose but time, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我除了时间什么都没有可失去的，Haruka。

lines.en: That’s a good joke since I {i}can’t{/i} lose time. Maya would laugh at it if she were here.
lines.zh: 这笑话不错，毕竟我是{i}没法{/i}失去时间的。Maya 要是在这儿肯定会笑。

lines.en: Just kidding. Maya doesn’t know how to laugh anymore.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。Maya 早就不会笑了。

lines.en: I want to say that’s kind of sad but, honestly, I can’t remember the last time I laughed either.
lines.zh: 我想说这有点可悲，但说实话，我也记不清自己上一次笑是什么时候了。

lines.en: I guess things just start to lose their comedic value once you’re made acutely aware of the incessance of life in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 大概一旦你清醒地意识到 Kumon-mi 的生活没完没了，那些事就开始失去喜剧价值了。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. I’d share my thoughts with you, but you probably wouldn’t want to-
lines.zh: : 别管了。我倒是想跟你分享我的想法，但你可能不会想——

lines.en: : Actually, wait. You’re probably one of the few people who {i}would{/i} want to hear my thoughts.
lines.zh: : 等等，其实。你大概是少数几个{i}愿意{/i}听我想法的人。

lines.en: : Or at least the more “entertaining” ones.
lines.zh: : 至少是愿意听那些比较“有意思”的。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas5
with dissolve
: Just make sure she doesn’t hear {i}all{/i} of your thoughts or she might get a little bit jealous and not want to help me decorate the bar anymore.
lines.zh: : 你只要别让她听见你{i}全部{/i}的想法就行，不然她可能会有点吃醋，然后就不想再帮我布置酒吧了。

lines.en: : Yes. Please drop more hints about your relationship. It’s not like I’m incredibly lonely or anything.
lines.zh: : 对。请再多抖一点你们关系的料。我又不是寂寞得要死什么的。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas6
with dissolve
: Hey, why should {i}I{/i} have to watch what I say when you’re the one who decided to get married super early in life?
lines.zh: : 喂，明明是你自己决定这辈子那么早就结婚的，凭什么{i}我{/i}要管住自己的嘴？

lines.en: : Says the girl who got herself impregnated when she was a teenager.
lines.zh: : 这话从那个十几岁就把自己搞怀孕的丫头嘴里说出来，还真有说服力。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas7
with dissolve
: I absolutely didn’t do it myself! That’s not how that works!
lines.zh: : 我绝对不是自己搞的！事情根本不是这么运作的！

lines.en: : You would know this if you hadn’t spent the last three years not having sex!
lines.zh: : 你要是过去三年不是一直没做过爱，就该知道这一点。

lines.en: if harukalust10 == True:
Oh, Sara. If only you knew.
lines.zh: 噢，Sara。你要是知道就好了。

lines.en: In other news, though- I’m glad to confirm that she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来——我很高兴能确认她并不知道。

lines.en: I figured that, by now, either Haruka or Maki would have said something about it, but...
lines.zh: 我原以为到现在，Haruka 或 Maki 总该有人提起过这事了，可是……

lines.en: Well, I can’t imagine Haruka would feel good about herself admitting that she was fucking the object of her best friend’s affection behind both her and her own husband’s back.
lines.zh: 好吧，我可以想象 Haruka 不会愿意承认自己背着最好朋友、也背着丈夫，在和对方心仪的对象上床。

lines.en: And I imagine Maki just hasn’t said anything because sex is as casual and meaningless to her as a trip to the movie theatre.
lines.zh: 而 Maki 大概只是没说，因为对她来说性就跟去趟电影院一样随意、一样没有意义。

lines.en: : Are you sure you want a beer and not just this entire bottle of Jagermeister? If you’re going to drink this early in the morning, you might as well go all in.
lines.zh: : 你确定你想要的只是啤酒，而不是直接来上整瓶野格？既然要一大早就喝，不如喝个痛快。

lines.en: : I think you should keep that bottle for yourself. It might help you deal with Sara’s relentless desire to flirt with me a little better.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那瓶你还是留着自己喝吧。也许能帮你更好地应付 Sara 那股不停想跟我调情的劲头。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas8
with dissolve
: I’d need a lot more than one bottle for that...
lines.zh: : 要对付那个，一瓶可远远不够……

lines.en: : Hey, I’ve been holding myself back pretty well this morning.
lines.zh: : 喂，我今天早上已经收敛得很好了。

lines.en: : You kind of have to if you want to have your bar serviceable for your alleged party tonight.
lines.zh: : 你想让你那间所谓的派对今晚还能用的话，确实得收敛点。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas9
with dissolve
: It’s not alleged! It’s a real party and there are going to be people spending money here! I mean it!
lines.zh: : 才不是所谓的！是真的有派对，今晚会有客人来这儿花钱的！我说真的！

lines.en: : I’ll believe it when I see it.
lines.zh: : 眼见为实。

lines.en: : Which I won’t, since I’m not coming tonight.
lines.zh: : 可惜我看不到，因为我今晚不来。

lines.en: : Which side of the bed did you wake up on today?! The floor?!
lines.zh: : 你今天是从床的哪一边爬起来的？！地板吗？！

lines.en: : I mean...I think everything looks pretty good now. All we really have to do is hang up the wreaths and decorate the trees.
lines.zh: : 我说……我觉得现在看起来已经挺不错了。我们真正剩下的活就是把花环挂起来、把圣诞树装饰好。

lines.en: : Then why did you even invite me here?...
lines.zh: : 那你到底为什么要叫我过来？……

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas10
with dissolve
: Hey, I told you I was only half serious about it. You’ve made it very clear by now that you don’t like lending a hand where it really matters.
lines.zh: : 喂，我都说了这事我只有半句当真。你现在已经说得很清楚了，在真正要紧的地方你就是不肯帮忙。

lines.en: : Weird. Because, from everything you’ve told me, he seems to lend you a {i}hand{/i} pretty often.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。因为按你说的那些，他倒是经常帮你{i}“搭把手”{/i}。

lines.en: : I get it. The hand is my penis.
lines.zh: : 我懂了。那只手就是我的鸡巴。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas11
with dissolve
: Yes. Yes it is.
lines.zh: : 对。就是。

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} a really good penis. And it has helped me a lot.
lines.zh: : 那{i}是{/i}一根很棒的鸡巴。而且它帮了我很多。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sara.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sara。

lines.en: : You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : Okay, this is starting to get weird again.
lines.zh: : 好了，这又开始变得怪起来了。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas12
with dissolve
: There’s nothing weird about two consenting adults having sex, Haruka! You’ve probably just forgotten all about that by now on account of the {i}three years without sex.{/i}
lines.zh: : 两个成年人你情我愿地上床，有什么好奇怪的，Haruka！你大概是因为{i}三年没做爱{/i}，早把这事忘干净了吧。

lines.en: Yet again, another hilariously ironic statement whizzes by without a single laugh.
lines.zh: 又一句讽刺到好笑的话呼啸而过，却连一声笑都没换来。

lines.en: : Just don’t screw each other on the bar, please. I wiped it down twice already and I really don’t want to do it a third time.
lines.zh: : 只是请你们别在吧台上做爱。我已经擦了两遍了，真的不想再擦第三遍。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas13
with dissolve
: What if I wipe it down? Is it okay then?
lines.zh: : 那如果我来擦呢？那样可以吗？

lines.en: : Sara, this is really not a thing you should be suggesting when there are going to be people allegedly sitting at this bar by the end of the day.
lines.zh: : Sara，今晚可是真的会有客人坐在这张吧台前的，你真不该提议这种事。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas14
with dissolve
: It’s not alleged! They’re coming!
lines.zh: : 不是所谓的！他们真的会来！

lines.en: : I sure hope so because you’re not even paying me for this and I’m pretty sure I’ve done more work than you.
lines.zh: : 但愿如此吧，你连工钱都不付给我，而我干的活我敢说比你还多。

lines.en: : Like, I gave up my entire Christmas for this pretty much.
lines.zh: : 比如说，我几乎把整个圣诞节都搭进来了。

lines.en: : Sure, but like, what else were you going to do with it?
lines.zh: : 是，可是话说回来，你要是不搭进来，还能拿它干什么呢？

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas15
with dissolve
: Hey!
: What? Christmas is a couples holiday and your husband is floating around in space right now.
lines.zh: : 怎么？圣诞节是情侣的节日，而你老公这会儿正在太空里飘着呢。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas16
with dissolve
: Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : What? Why are you asking me?
lines.zh: : 什么？你干嘛问我？

lines.en: : Because you obviously came here since we’re practically a couple and, even if you can’t come for the {i}real party{/i} that is happening tonight, you still wanted to see me.
lines.zh: : 因为你显然是因为我们差不多就是一对才来的，而且就算你不能来今晚那场{i}真的会办{/i}的派对，你也还是想见我。

lines.en: : And I obviously wanted to spend it with you since I put on this cute holiday outfit and stuff!
lines.zh: : 而我显然是想跟你一起过的，不然我干嘛穿上这身可爱的节日装什么的！

lines.en: : Do you need a glass of water, Sara? Because you seem really thirsty today.
lines.zh: : 你需要来杯水吗，Sara？因为你今天看起来真的很渴。

lines.en: : Yes, Haruka. I do believe I’m feeling rather parched.
lines.zh: : 是的，Haruka。我确实觉得自己挺口干舌燥的。

lines.en: : Get a room.
lines.zh: : 去开个房吧。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas17
with dissolve
: I have a room. I just wouldn’t want you down here listening to the two of us because I know it would make you jealous.
lines.zh: : 我有房间。我只是不想让你在楼下听着我们俩，因为我知道你会吃醋。

lines.en: : Why? It’s not like I haven’t heard you two go at it before.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我又不是没听过你们两个折腾。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas18
with dissolve
: Wait, what? You did? When?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？你听过？什么时候？

lines.en: if saralust10 == True:
: Uhh...the Halloween party when you decided to dress like a nurse? You weren’t very subtle about it.
lines.zh: : 呃……就是那次万圣节派对，你决定打扮成护士的那次？你们可一点也不含蓄。

lines.en: else:
: I don’t know, Sara. It’s not like I keep track of all of the times I’ve heard you two fuck.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Sara。我又不是把你俩做爱的每一次都记着。

lines.en: : That’s...actually really embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 那……其实挺丢人的。

lines.en: : Did I sound weird?
lines.zh: : 我听起来怪吗？

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas19
with dissolve
: {i}What?{/i}
: Or was it like...hot?
lines.zh: : 还是说，那个……很带劲？

lines.en: : Because if my friend heard me having sex, I wouldn’t want it to sound weird. I’d want it to sound hot.
lines.zh: : 因为如果换作是我朋友听见我做爱，我不会想让它听起来很怪。我想让它听起来很带劲。

lines.en: : Have you been sneaking wine behind my back this morning or something? What are you even saying right now?
lines.zh: : 你今早是不是偷偷在我背后喝了点葡萄酒什么的？你现在到底在说什么啊？

lines.en: : Curiosity isn’t a crime, Haruka. Did it sound like good sex or not?
lines.zh: : 好奇又不是犯罪，Haruka。听起来到底算不算一场好性爱？

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas20
with dissolve
: I don’t know, Sara...I don’t really remember...
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Sara……我真不太记得了……

lines.en: : Really? Because I’m pretty sure I’d remember how you sounded if you had sex on the floor above me.
lines.zh: : 是吗？因为我敢说，如果你在我楼上做爱，我一定会记得你听起来是什么样。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, it’s not like you have to worry about that any time soon.
lines.zh: : 是吗，不过你短期内都不用操心这事。

lines.en: : True. And it’s not like I’d ever let you borrow Sensei or anything.
lines.zh: : 没错。而且我也绝不会把 Sensei 借给你什么的。

lines.en: : I was not aware that it was up to you to lend me out.
lines.zh: : 我倒是不知道借不借还由你说了算。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas21
with dissolve
: But Haruka is married. She’s obviously not allowed to have sex with you.
lines.zh: : 可 Haruka 已经结婚了。她显然不能跟你做爱。

lines.en: : I think Haruka is {i}allowed{/i} to do whatever she-
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Haruka 想做什么都——

lines.en: : She’s allowed to watch {i}us{/i} if she wants, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她想看的话，是可以看{i}我们{/i}的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what was that?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你刚才说什么？

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas22
with dissolve
: Uhh...yeah. What?
lines.zh: : 呃……啊？什么？

lines.en: : {i}Watching{/i} a couple have sex isn’t really cheating, right? So there’s not really any rule against that.
lines.zh: : {i}看{/i}一对情侣做爱应该不算出轨吧？所以应该没有哪条规矩不许这个。

lines.en: : Do you...want me to watch you two have sex?...
lines.zh: : 你……想让我看着你俩做爱？……

lines.en: : Me? Ehh.
lines.zh: : 我吗？呃。

lines.en: : I’m indifferent. But if you just so happened to accidentally stumble upon something like that and decided to stick around and finger yourself, I’d get it.
lines.zh: : 我无所谓。但如果你刚好不小心撞见这种场面，然后决定留下来自己用手指解决一下，我能理解。

lines.en: : You need all the help you can get at this point.
lines.zh: : 到了这个地步，你可是能捞到多少帮助就该捞多少。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas23
with dissolve
: I’m not saying I’d expect you to do something like that since it’s definitely weird and not a thing you'd ever really {i}ask{/i} to do, but-
lines.zh: : 我不是说我指望你干这种事，因为这确实很怪，也不是你真会{i}开口要求{/i}干的事，但是——

lines.en: : Haruka?
lines.zh: : Haruka？

lines.en: : Hello?
: So...you’d let me watch...but I wouldn’t be allowed to join in?
lines.zh: : 所以……你愿意让我看……但不让我加入？

lines.en: : And it would be completely fine even though I’m married?
lines.zh: : 而且就算我已经结婚了，这也完全没关系？

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas24
with dissolve
: Wait, you're not actually being serious right now, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等，你现在不是认真的吧？

lines.en: : That entirely depends on whether or not you’re joking.
lines.zh: : 那完全取决于你是不是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : If anyone wants my opinion, I’m all for it.
lines.zh: : 如果有人想听我的意见，我举双手赞成。

lines.en: scene saraharukaxmas25
with dissolve
: You are?!
lines.zh: : 你是认真的？！

lines.en: : I know that shouldn’t surprise me, but I feel like this is actually a thing that’s about to happen and I’m starting to feel a little nervous!
lines.zh: : 我知道这不该让我惊讶，可我感觉这事是真的要发生了，我开始有点紧张了！

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : You know what, I’m game. Let’s do it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我奉陪。来吧。

lines.en: : It's not like Sara’s paying me to help out, so this could at least count as, like...{i}some{/i} type of payment.
lines.zh: : 反正 Sara 又不付我工钱，那这至少能算作……{i}某种{/i}报酬吧。

lines.en: scene black
with dissolve2
stop music fadeout 20.0
: Well said, Haruka. I was thinking the same exact thing.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Haruka。我刚才也是这么想的。

lines.en: : Wait! Hold on, I was only being half serious about this! It’s happening way too quickly!
lines.zh: : 等等！等一下，这事我只有一半是认真的！进展太快了！

lines.en: : Oh, shut up. You wouldn’t have suggested it if you didn’t want it, Sara.
lines.zh: : 噢，闭嘴吧。你要是不想要，根本就不会提出来，Sara。

lines.en: : Don’t listen to Sara. She’s just worried about sounding weird.
lines.zh: : 别听 Sara 的。她只是怕自己听起来很怪。

lines.en: : No, hold on! We still haven’t decorated the tree! And the wreaths aren’t going to hang themselves!
lines.zh: : 不，等一下！我们还没装饰圣诞树呢！花环也不会自己挂上去！

lines.en: : Guys!
lines.zh: : 喂喂！
